info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Healthcare Appointments Checkin-v2-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Check-in API enables healthcare providers to facilitate patient check-ins for scheduled appointments. This endpoint streamlines the process of confirming a patient's arrival, improving operational efficiency and enhancing the patient experience. It is typically used by medical staff and administrative personnel to manage patient flows and minimize wait times. By integrating this API, health organizations can ensure a smoother check-in process, allowing healthcare professionals to focus on patient care.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to check in for their scheduled appointments, updating their status to indicate they have arrived. Essential for managing appointment flow and ensuring timely service.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to check in a patient for their scheduled appointment. It contains the necessary information for the appointment check-in process.

204.description: Check-in completed successfully with no content returned.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the appointment.

customer.description: Details of the customer associated with the request.

resource.description: The resource related to the appointment.

priority.description: The priority level of the appointment.

amount.description: The amount associated with the appointment.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the appointment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the appointment is requested.
